أن: Indeed, if a person were to perform an obligatory act within it, it would be as if he had performed seventy obligatory acts at other times.
منها: Some of them are questions about Allah Almighty, and Sheikh al-Islam Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Taymiyyah, may Allah have mercy on him, answered them.
ويبينونه: And they will make it clear
تشوبها: It has a flaw or blemish.
يكدرها: I can make it difficult for her
يسكت: He/She remains silent or is silenced.
ويبوسة: The translation of 'ويبوسة' is 'And he will have a boil.'
والتجهم: The act of being dark or gloomy
حلت: It has been decreed or determined.
ولواحقه: And its subsequent parts or consequences.
وستعقبها: And it will be followed by
والمستأمنون: And those who seek refuge and security
وتحرج: And it becomes difficult or distressing
الإحباط: The feeling of defeat or despair.
المفضية: The one that leads or causes
يصلحون: They prepare or make things right.
لقد: He was generous and kind to people, treating them with kindness and courtesy until he died, may Allah have mercy on him.
رحمهما: May Allah have mercy upon them.
والخارج: And the one who goes out
والتنزه: And the act of taking a stroll or wandering about
الكاهل-: The one who is well-versed or experienced.
الفتانين: The two who are tested or tempted.
ومتعنا: And He has granted us enjoyment
وسوسته: And he made them even or proportionate.
